  • Subject: <HSNAME>;<XUNAME> <FOO> for LISP
  • From: JPG at MIT-MC (Jeffrey P. Golden)
  • Date: Mon, 25 Sep 78 08:37:00 GMT
  • Original-date: 25 SEP 1978 0437-EDT
In response to GLS's and RWK's responses to my note on this, 
as far as the STATUS function is concerned, I think LISP should 
provide (STATUS HSNAME) and (STATUS XUNAME) when the time comes.
This will make things more uniform and simpler as that is what 
these frobs appear to be called.  If this should make any of the 
existing STATUS args obsolete, then they can eventually be phased 
out.  But during the transition period, e.g. (STATUS USERID) and 
(STATUS UDIR) and whatever other related STATUS args there are 
should continue to be computed as they are now.
